_note: Template only - the loader skips every file whose name starts with '_'. Copy it to e.g. sleepy.json and set "archetype": "sleepy" in a character file to use it. An archetype is a shared personality pool: several characters can point at the same one.
_shape: reactions = event -> lines. states = <tag> -> lines (or <tag> -> {event: lines, '*': lines}). chat_topics and pair_lines are merged into the shared topics; a character or pair file wins.
_events: 'idle' is standing around. 'state_enter' / 'state_exit' fire once when the computer state starts or stops - the right place for a line about a specific game or site, phrased in this personality. A plain list answers EVERY event, so scope it.
_placeholders: {name} and {me} are the speaker, {other} the listener, {pronoun} her pronoun. From the watcher: {app} 'Genshin Impact', {site} 'youtube', {battery} '42%', {time} '14:05', {focus_minutes}, {session_minutes}.
